{{Top|leg}}
'''SkillWare''' was the official name given to the programming a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was installed with. SkillWare allowed droids to perform a variety of functions,<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> such as piloting ability, assembling a weapon, speaking a language, counting cards, or slicing into a computer system. These programs fleshed out a droid's array of talents and their hardwired [[TraitWare]] abilities.<ref name="NEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
